create.name: Jane Burns
create.bio:
Jane Burns is a shamanic practitioner, teacher and writer in Southbury, Connecticut, whose work draws on the old spiritual ways of Ireland, Scotland and Wales. A serious illness in 1996 set her on the shamanic path. She went on to study core shamanism, soul retrieval and teacher training with Sandra Ingerman, and Celtic shamanism and the Irish tradition of faery doctoring with Tom Cowan. She has practised with clients since 2005 and taught shamanic journeying since 2007, is a Celtic Reiki master, and has led workshops for the Society for Shamanic Practice, whose journal she helps edit.

Her practice, Journeys to the Soul, offers long one-to-one sessions in which the journey itself shapes the work, which may include soul retrieval, power animal retrieval, reading a client's soul archetype and ancestral work, in person at her barn for most of the year or over Zoom. She also runs a year-long mentorship for people finding their way on the shamanic path or building a practice, and a monthly practitioner training in the Celtic tradition. Since 2019 she has taught online courses with The Shift Network on Celtic wisdom, virtues and times of transition. She is the author of the novel and journeying handbook Up a Tree, a second novel, The Hungry Sea, and a Celtic tree oracle deck.

courses.title: Shamanic healing session
courses.description: A two-hour one-to-one session whose shape is set by the shamanic journey, which may bring together soul retrieval, ancestral work, a reading of your soul archetype and the return of a power animal. Held at her barn in Southbury from March to November, or on Zoom all year.

courses.title: Mentorship Program
courses.description: Six two-hour one-to-one sessions spread over most of a year, shaped to the person: deeper healing work, learning to live on the shamanic path, or turning existing training into a client practice.

courses.title: The Powerful Transformations Hidden in the Betwixt and Between
courses.description: A seven-week self-paced course with The Shift Network on the in-between times of life, when the old falls away before the new arrives. It works through Celtic tales, guided shamanic journeys and practices.

courses.title: Celtic Shamanism: Rituals, Myths and Journeys for Reclaiming Your Sovereignty
courses.description: A seven-module self-paced course with The Shift Network built around the Celtic wisdom wheel, with rituals of gratitude, courage and wonder for reconnecting with the land and the sacred.

courses.title: Celtic Virtues to Cultivate Lasting Peace
courses.description: A ten-module self-paced course with The Shift Network on ten virtues prized by the ancient Celts, from courage and presence to surrender and peace, taught through stories, sacred trees and practices.
